architecture.inject: Kill the authoritative writer between persist, metadata handoff and downstream publication
architecture.oracle: Row/business invariants remain consistent across replays and mutually incompatible readers
architecture.recover: Revert traffic to last verified publication manifest or snapshot

batch-ingestion/cdc.focus: CDC positions, snapshots and schema evolution
batch-ingestion/cdc.inject: Interrupt snapshot-to-stream transition and inject DDL, deletes and an unavailable log segment
batch-ingestion/cdc.oracle: One logical change is reproducibly accounted for using position+key, with no silent missing deletes
batch-ingestion/cdc.recover: Resume from a verified cursor/LSN/SCN or restore full snapshot with deduplicated replay

batch-ingestion/elasticsearch.inject: Expire a PIT and fail a shard/page after a successful partial batch
batch-ingestion/elasticsearch.oracle: A unique document-version or stable primary key set reconciles with target counts
batch-ingestion/elasticsearch.recover: Reuse persisted day/page cache or restart a fresh consistent extraction window

batch-ingestion/recovery.inject: Crash after target publication but before checkpoint then rerun the same date
batch-ingestion/recovery.oracle: Backfill rerun yields identical partition/business values without duplicate effects
batch-ingestion/recovery.recover: Restore last published partition manifest and bounded replay

batch-ingestion.inject: Fail between source page and durable target checkpoint; replay duplicates
batch-ingestion.oracle: Input keys and control totals match durable output across retries
batch-ingestion.recover: Restart at committed source point, keeping raw artifacts for reconciliation

cloud.focus: Managed cloud service API and billing boundaries
cloud.inject: Inject regional API throttling or loss of identity permissions mid-load
cloud.oracle: No unauthorized access or unbounded retry/cost; table outcomes remain reconcilable
cloud.recover: Stop jobs, reconcile partial cloud artifacts and redeploy pinned configuration

data-migration.inject: Switch consumers during target catch-up then fail a writer
data-migration.oracle: Source and target compare on business keys, late updates and deletes at an agreed cutover watermark
data-migration.recover: Return traffic to verified old source while keeping dual-write effects fenced

dataops.inject: Deploy incompatible schema or partial pipeline artifact under concurrent run
dataops.oracle: Old and new consumers maintain verified contract and lineage
dataops.recover: Roll back immutable artifact and compensate or quarantine incompatible publication

distributed-processing/flink.inject: Corrupt checkpoint or restore with changed operator UID/parallelism
distributed-processing/flink.oracle: Source replay and sink effects reconcile; state schema migration is explicitly validated
distributed-processing/flink.recover: Restore compatible savepoint and prevent dual writers

distributed-processing/spark.focus: Spark distributed query correctness and state
distributed-processing/spark.inject: Inject executor loss, skew/hot key, stale cached plan or stateful restart
distributed-processing/spark.oracle: Result counts and business keys remain correct across retry and adaptive plans
distributed-processing/spark.recover: Return to previous artifact/streaming checkpoint with sink idempotence

distributed-processing.inject: Force worker loss, network partition and memory pressure during shuffle
distributed-processing.oracle: No data loss/duplication beyond explicitly stated sink guarantees
distributed-processing.recover: Resume from durable partitions/checkpoints or discard uncommitted output

formats.focus: Schema encoding and cross-runtime type fidelity
formats.inject: Round-trip nested/null/decimal/timestamp values across independent readers
formats.oracle: Field identity, logical types and backward compatibility remain intact
formats.recover: Retain prior schema and isolate incompatible assets

foundations.focus: Data model grain and reproducible lifecycle
foundations.inject: Replay late update/delete and mutate source schema under an existing model
foundations.oracle: Business grain, temporal validity and schema evolution remain auditable
foundations.recover: Version model contracts and rebuild affected partitions

governance.inject: Revoke permissions and rotate credentials while cached reader remains active
governance.oracle: Deny-by-default access, correct masking and durable audit provenance
governance.recover: Block affected consumers and restore reviewed least-privilege policy

ingestion.focus: Connector state, pagination and external quotas
ingestion.inject: Repeat pages after timeout, expire token and rate limit midway
ingestion.oracle: Source progress advances only after target commit, and deduplication is deterministic
ingestion.recover: Resume from last confirmed cursor; quarantine ambiguous writes

lakehouse/catalogs.focus: Catalog control plane and commit contention
lakehouse/catalogs.inject: Fail credential vending or catalog commit after object upload
lakehouse/catalogs.oracle: Published metadata pointer and object permissions remain consistent; retries do not fork authoritative history
lakehouse/catalogs.recover: Re-read catalog state before retry; preserve last validated table snapshot

lakehouse/iceberg.focus: Iceberg snapshot, field-ID and partition evolution
lakehouse/iceberg.inject: Concurrently rewrite files and expire snapshots while readers pin older refs
lakehouse/iceberg.oracle: Protected refs, field-ID compatibility and visible rows remain valid
lakehouse/iceberg.recover: Restore retained snapshot only when data files still exist; otherwise fail closed

lakehouse.inject: Fail object upload or metadata commit during simultaneous writers
lakehouse.oracle: Reader-visible snapshot atomicity and delete semantics are proven for installed engine versions
lakehouse.recover: Quarantine uncommitted files; restore last readable catalog head

messaging/kafka.focus: Kafka offset, transaction and rebalance semantics
messaging/kafka.inject: Rebalance after sink write but before offset commit; replay a poisoned event
messaging/kafka.oracle: Sink deduplication and source offset recovery reconcile with input partition order
messaging/kafka.recover: Pause, recover offsets and replay from retained log with idempotent sink writes

messaging.focus: Broker ack, ordering and consumer replay
messaging.inject: Fail consumer after ack and change partition assignments during backlog
messaging.oracle: No silently lost/duplicated business effects beyond declared delivery model
messaging.recover: Recover from durable broker position and bounded DLQ redrive

observability.focus: Freshness and quality SLO signal fidelity
observability.inject: Delay source arrival while metrics pipeline appears healthy
observability.oracle: SLO measures source-to-consumer availability, not just DAG status
observability.recover: Declare breach and execute runbook with bounded catch-up

orchestration.inject: Re-run overlapping windows during scheduler failover and DST boundary
orchestration.oracle: Each declared data interval has one durable accepted output
orchestration.recover: Pause competing runs; reprocess impacted intervals with safe overwrite/merge

performance.inject: Introduce hot-key skew or spill under representative peak concurrency
performance.oracle: Same result cardinality and business invariants with measurable p95 and cost gains
performance.recover: Revert resource limits or plan changes if correctness/regression guardrails fail

quality.focus: Data contract checks and lineage of failures
quality.inject: Inject null/duplicate/late records and schema drift in an empty partition
quality.oracle: Bad batches are quarantined; false positives, false negatives and coverage are reported
quality.recover: Stop promotion, backfill clean batch and preserve previous accepted snapshot

reliability.inject: Crash between target commit and checkpoint plus network timeout on retry
reliability.oracle: Recovery yields stable business keys and measurable RPO/RTO under simulated failure
reliability.recover: Reconcile partial publication then replay only unsafe/unfinished units

serving.focus: Serving consumer consistency and external side-effects
serving.inject: Retry activation after partial success while serving schema changes
serving.oracle: Per-consumer contract, authorization and idempotence hold across retries
serving.recover: Disable propagation and reconcile changed destination records

storage.inject: Remove/deny object access while writer upload completes or metadata is cached
storage.oracle: Data content and metadata are reconstructible from verified copies
storage.recover: Restore immutable backups and reconcile storage inventory

streaming/sql-engines.inject: Insert out-of-order updates/retractions under high watermark lag
streaming/sql-engines.oracle: Materialized view equals reference batch computation after convergence
streaming/sql-engines.recover: Rebuild from source log or restore verified snapshot

streaming.focus: Event-time, offsets and sink delivery contracts
streaming.inject: Inject late events, duplicate retries and restart with divergent state
streaming.oracle: Event-time windows and output effects follow explicitly proven guarantee
streaming.recover: Rewind replayable source and perform idempotent/transactional sink recovery

transformation.focus: SQL transformation grain and incremental materialization
transformation.inject: Backfill old partition after schema change and fail publish halfway
transformation.oracle: Full refresh and incremental runs agree on effective grain/metrics
transformation.recover: Replace staged output atomically where supported or restore prior partition

unstructured.inject: Ingest corrupt encodings, oversized documents and revoked content
unstructured.oracle: Extracted records retain provenance, access permissions and deterministic reprocessing
unstructured.recover: Quarantine bad inputs and revoke derived outputs when source deleted

warehouse/trino.inject: Fail one source or change cardinality while a cross-catalog join spills
warehouse/trino.oracle: Results match a materialized/control query, with bounded source impact
warehouse/trino.recover: Cancel/fence faulty query and revert pushed-down plan/settings

warehouse/starrocks.focus: Primary keys, tablet distribution and load lifecycle
warehouse/starrocks.inject: Retry Stream Load after unknown response and trigger compaction while reads run
warehouse/starrocks.oracle: No duplicate primary-key effects; load labels and partition counts reconcile
warehouse/starrocks.recover: Check load transaction/label state before resubmission; restore prior published slice

warehouse/cloud.inject: Interrupt COPY/MERGE after API timeout with warehouse resource throttling
warehouse/cloud.oracle: Statement and ingestion outcomes reconcile with billing and snapshot state
warehouse/cloud.recover: Resolve transaction status and resume from verified staged files

warehouse.focus: OLAP schema design and cross-engine query behavior
warehouse.inject: Load duplicate and late update keys under partition skew and stale materialized view
warehouse.oracle: Query result, primary/aggregate semantics and refresh lag meet recorded SLO
warehouse.recover: Revert schema/MV or rebuild affected partitions from replayable staging
